name: seadex-scout
description: Report-only watcher flagging better SeaDex releases for a Sonarr/Radarr anime library. Compares your Sonarr/Radarr anime library against SeaDex (the community-curated index of the best anime releases) and tells you, per title, when SeaDex recommends a better release than the one on disk. It never downloads or touches a torrent client: it writes a report and a warning log line, and you decide. Optionally serves the SeaDex picks as a Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: config.yaml, state and the reports folder

ports.name: Torznab port
ports.description: Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr; only listens when a Torznab URL is configured in config.yaml

variables.name: Sonarr URL
variables.description: Where seadex-scout reaches Sonarr, including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:8989 (use the server's LAN IP, not a container name)

variables.name: Sonarr API key
variables.description: Sonarr's API key, from Sonarr: Settings, General, API Key

variables.name: Radarr URL
variables.description: Where seadex-scout reaches Radarr, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:7878; leave empty to watch Sonarr only

variables.name: Radarr API key
variables.description: Radarr's API key, from Radarr: Settings, General, API Key; required when Radarr URL is set
